beachesSwimming.overview: Zanzibar's water stays warm (79-84°F) year-round; the real disruption is the 'long rains' (roughly Mar-May), which bring rougher seas and lower visibility, not colder water.

diving.overview: Zanzibar's Mnemba Atoll is the real diving draw here — healthy coral, turtles, and a real chance of whale sharks between October and March. It's a genuinely different trip from the mainland safari the country is best known for.

windSports.overview: Paje, on Zanzibar's east coast, is a world-class kitesurfing beach with two real monsoon wind seasons — the stronger Kusi (May through October) and the lighter Kaskazi (December through March). April, in the middle of Tanzania's long rains, is the genuine dead spot; November is also a quiet in-between month.
